findings.summary: The reader typed 750 for the monthly deposit, but the slider shows 800, so they can't tell which amount the result uses.
The inflation figure only shows after pressing a small grey button, and the line about the dollar and the ECB next to it is confusing.
Tax is the biggest cost (15,364 of 18,299 ₪), which feels alarming, and the small print '84% מהפסד' is unclear.
The two best options differ by only 122 ₪, and the reader can't see why to choose one over the other.
The fund chips use jargon (צוברת, עסקת החלף, מנוטרלת מט״ח), so the reader skipped them.
